sites.name: Dien Hai Citadel
sites.event: A special national relic, an important military fortress that contributed to defeating the French - Spanish forces in the first invasion battle (1858 - 1860).

sites.name: Ngu Hanh Son (Non Nuoc) Scenic Landscape
sites.event: A special national relic, a complex of 5 limestone mountains containing many caves and pagodas, which once served as a revolutionary base.

sites.name: Da Nang Museum of Cham Sculpture
sites.event: The place that preserves and displays the world's largest collection of Cham sculpture art, built by the French in 1915.

sites.name: Son Tra Peninsula (Tien Sa Mountain)
sites.event: Known as the 'green lung' of Da Nang, it has an important military strategic location and a diverse ecosystem (red-shanked douc langur).

sites.name: Hai Van Pass (Hai Van Gate)
sites.event: Named 'the most grandiose gateway in the world' by King Le Thanh Tong, it is a natural and historical boundary between Thua Thien Hue and Da Nang.

sites.name: K20 Revolutionary Base
sites.event: A resistance secret zone located right in the heart of enemy territory, famous for its secret tunnel system used to shelter officers and commando soldiers.

sites.name: Ba Na Hills (Chua Mountain)
sites.event: Once a French resort from the early 20th century, it is now a famous tourist destination featuring the Golden Bridge.

sites.name: Phuoc Ninh Cemetery of Righteous Soldiers
sites.event: The gathering place for the remains of righteous soldiers and compatriots who sacrificed their lives in the resistance war against the French (1858-1860).

sites.name: Nam O Reef
sites.event: A famous green moss-covered rocky beach located next to the ancient Nam O fishing village (home to a long-standing traditional fish sauce craft).

sites.name: Linh Ung Bai But Pagoda
sites.event: Famous for its 67m-tall Lady Buddha statue facing the East Sea, serving as a spiritual anchor for fishermen.

sites.name: Hai Chau Communal House
sites.event: The oldest communal house in Da Nang, preserving royal decrees and evidence of the Vietnamese southward expansion process.

sites.name: Gieng Troi
sites.event: A primeval forest area with waterfalls and natural lakes deep in the mountains, a famous trekking destination.
